02 / Heritage

Technology
runs in the family.

Founded by Chinese technology entrepreneurs with deep roots in Silicon Valley and Asia, Evergreen Growth brings an operator’s perspective to every investment decision.

We have built, scaled, and exited technology companies. We understand what founders need, and what it takes to win.

  1. 01

    Long-Term View

    Permanent capital and a multi-decade horizon. No artificial exit pressure.

  2. 02

    Operator Insight

    Our founders built and scaled technology companies before turning to investment.

  3. 03

    Deep Tech Focus

    AI, semiconductors, enterprise software, and blockchain — where real moats are built.

  4. 04

    East + West

    Fluent in Silicon Valley venture culture and Chinese technology innovation.
